items.title: OpenAI pledges to pay for data center power after election highlights AI concerns

items.summary_zh: OpenAI 承诺就 AI 数据中心征求社区意见、公布建设计划并保护电费承担者。

items.summary_zh: 作者 | 周智宇 丰田在将自己汽车产业中的能力，运用到更宽阔的能源生态当中

items.title: Want a ceasefire? Pay $51 billion first, as Saudi-Houthi secret contacts are revealed
items.title_zh: 想停战？先付510亿美元，沙特与胡塞武装秘密接触曝光
items.summary: The Wall Street Journal reported on 4 November, citing multiple people familiar with the matter, that after Houthi attacks on Saudi tankers in the Red Sea and the group's seizure of a key area of the Bab al-Mandab strait, Saudi Arabia approached the Houthis to explore a negotiated end to hostilities; the Houthi condition was $51 billion.
items.summary_zh: 美国《华尔街日报》当地时间11月4日援引多名知情人士消息披露， 在也门胡塞武装袭击红海海域的沙特油轮，并控制战略要地曼德海峡关键地区后，沙特方面曾与胡塞武装接触，试图探寻通过谈判停止敌对行动的可能性，胡塞武装开出的条件是：510亿美元

items.title: China Everbright Bank's profit tug of war

items.summary_zh: 光大银行等来了收入增长，却还没有等来利润修复

items.title: Ructions begin: the first scapegoat after the Republican rout is about to appear
items.title_zh: 闹起来了！共和党惨败后的第一个“替罪羊”，要出现了……
items.summary: After the US midterms on 3 November ended in a heavy defeat for the governing Republicans, the party is already preparing to settle scores with those blamed for the political Waterloo.
items.summary_zh: 在当地时间11月3日举行的美国中期选举，以目前执政的共和党惨败收场后，共和党内部已经开始准备“清算”引发这场政治“滑铁卢”的“罪人”了

items.title: Life-insurance assumed-rate research value falls to 1.9%, not yet triggering product repricing

items.summary: The research value for life-insurance assumed rates has ended two consecutive quarters of gains and returned to 1.9%.
items.summary_zh: 人身险预定利率研究值结束了连续两个季度的上涨，重新回到1.9%
